coordinateDerivation.description: Project-authored arithmetic converts Wiki tile coordinates to standard region keys. Wiki provenance supports the input coordinates; no Wiki statement of the numeric ID formula was found.

omitted: Unreviewed crossings and gates stay unknown
Generic living trees need exact locations; reviewed dead trees provide normal logs at level 1
Gated places and dungeons are left out
Quests, equipment and drops come in later batches
Shop access checks tools and bait sources, not coins, inventory or stock depletion
Paid boats are conditional; landing areas and fares do not grant automatic access
